root_cause.text: Missing NULL check for `cl->device` in `ishtp_bus_remove_all_clients` when a warm reset occurs while clients are still being enumerated, causing a NULL pointer dereference when accessing `cl->device->reference_count`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a defensive NULL check `cl->device &&` before accessing `cl->device->reference_count` in the warm reset branch of `ishtp_bus_remove_all_clients`. The CVE description and call trace confirm the null-ptr-deref at `ishtp_bus_remove_all_clients+0xbe`, and state that the `cl->device` pointer may be NULL if reset occurs during client enumeration.
